An update is available for php-pecl-xdebug, module.php-pear, module.libzip, module.php-pecl-rrd, php, module.php-pecl-xdebug, php-pecl-zip, module.php-pecl-zip, module.php-pecl-apcu, libzip, php-pear, php-pecl-apcu, php-pecl-rrd, module.php.
This update affects Rocky Linux 8.
A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE list
notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
PHP is an HTML-embedded scripting language commonly used with the Apache HTTP Server.

Security Fix(es):

* php: php: Out-of-bounds read via empty HTTP redirect Location header (CVE-2026-93682)

* php: PHP: Archive entry injection via integer overflow in TAR parser (CVE-2026-6103)

* php: PHP: Denial of Service via heap buffer overflow in SOAP client (CVE-2025-14181)

* php: php: Denial of Service via unbounded recursion in SOAP parser (CVE-2026-91765)

* php: php: Credential disclosure via cross-origin HTTP redirects (CVE-2026-91766)

* php: php: Information disclosure via crafted TLS server certificate (CVE-2026-91767)

* php: php: Denial of Service via out-of-bounds read in mysqlnd wire protocol parser (CVE-2025-1218)

* php: php: Access control bypass via partial IPv6 address comparison (CVE-2026-91768)

* php: php: Information disclosure via out-of-bounds read in stream filters (CVE-2026-92842)

* php: php: Server impersonation via Common Name fallback in TLS verification (CVE-2026-91769)

* php: OOM bailout during request parsing leads to memory corruption and RCE (CVE-2026-109618)

* php: fatal error handling retains stale request state leading to use-after-free (CVE-2026-109619)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

This advisory is provided by Ctrl IQ, Inc for Rocky Linux systems. For more information about CIQ security practices, visit https://ciq.com/security.
